item.title: Hubble 1.1.17
item.description:
Hubble 1.1.17
Hubble 1.1.17: reliable button saves and cut/paste
- Fixes Command-X and paste for workbook cells and ranges. Cut waits for the clipboard before clearing cells, supports undo, and preserves moved formula references. - Fixes Companion button layout saves that failed after adding or editing several buttons together. - Shows clearer layout save errors and records the affected page and failure reason in Status Log. - Limits the Router page to modules added to the active workspace and shows their workspace names.
Verified with focused regression tests and live checks in the signed, installed apps. Existing workspaces, connections, and presets are preserved.
